mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sr_study_task (plan_id, account_id, tutorial_id, chapter_id, target_type, target_id, task_date, sequence_no, status, generation_version) VALUES (#{planId}, #{accountId}, #{tutorialId}, #{chapterId}, 'CHAPTER', #{chapterId}, #{taskDate}, #{sequenceNo}, 'TODO', #{version})
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_study_task SET status = 'OVERDUE' WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND task_date < #{today} AND status = 'TODO'
UPDATE sr_study_task SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{taskId} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
